newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close at highest level for five weeks.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close at highest level for five weeks.

text.p: UK shares rose to five-week highs on Wednesday, lifted Tuesday's buoyant Wall Street, where hopes for continued strong profit growth helped spark the biggest one-day Dow rise in point terms for ten years.
Shrugging off the Bank of England's latest call for higher interest rates, the FTSE 100 index closed up 41.6 points at 4,387.7, with gainers in a four-to-one majority. (corrects closing index).

Barclays helped drive the advance after Tuesday's upbeat trading statement, leading other bank stocks higher. Insurers also rose, spurred by an upgrade on Royal Sun from Goldman Sachs and benefiting from general market strength.
